task1.title: World's top three exporters of different fresh citrus fruits, 2018
task1.prompt: The charts below give information about the world's top three exporters of different fresh citrus fruits in 2018.

chartDesc.overview: Oranges accounted for the highest overall export volumes among all categories, led by South Africa. Mexico heavily dominated the 'Other types of citrus fruits' category with a vast margin over its competitors.
keyFeatures: South Africa was the top exporter of oranges at 1,050 thousand metric tons, followed by Egypt (900) and the United States (700).
Turkey was the leading exporter of lemons at 500 thousand metric tons, followed by Mexico (450) and Argentina (250).
United States and South Africa tied for the highest grapefruit exports at 250 thousand metric tons each, above Turkey (180).
Mexico dominated 'Other types of citrus fruits' with 450 thousand metric tons, whereas Israel and the United States exported only 6 and 4 thousand metric tons respectively.

task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features and make comparisons where relevant.
task1.sampleBand8:
The four bar charts show the three leading exporters of oranges, lemons, grapefruits and other citrus fruits in 2018, with all quantities measured in thousands of metric tons.

Overall, oranges were exported in far greater volumes than any other citrus fruit, and no single country dominated across every category. The United States and South Africa were the most versatile exporters, each appearing in the top three for more than one fruit, whereas the "other citrus" market was overwhelmingly controlled by a single country.

Oranges were by far the largest export. South Africa led with 1,050 thousand metric tons, followed by Egypt with 900 and the United States with 700. Lemons were exported on a smaller scale, headed by Turkey at 500, with Mexico close behind on 450 and Argentina trailing at 250 — exactly half the leader's figure.

Grapefruit exports were smaller still and remarkably even: the United States and South Africa tied at the top with 250 thousand metric tons each, while Turkey exported 180. The "other citrus" chart, by contrast, was strikingly lopsided: Mexico exported 450 thousand metric tons, but Israel and the United States managed a mere 6 and 4 respectively — a negligible amount by comparison.

Umuman olganda, apelsin boshqa har qanday sitrus mevasidan ancha ko'proq hajmda eksport qilingan va hech bir mamlakat barcha toifalarda ustunlik qilmagan. AQSh va Janubiy Afrika eng ko'pqirrali eksportchilar bo'lib, har biri bir nechta meva bo'yicha uchtalik ichida ko'ringan, "boshqa sitrus" bozori esa asosan bitta mamlakat tomonidan nazorat qilingan.

Limon kichikroq miqyosda eksport qilindi: 500 bilan Turkiya boshda turdi, 450 bilan Meksika unga yaqin orqada, Argentina esa 250 bilan — yetakchining ko'rsatkichidan roppa-rosa yarmi — ortda qoldi.

Greypfrut eksporti undan ham kichikroq va hayratlanarli darajada tekis bo'ldi: AQSh va Janubiy Afrika har biri 250 ming metrik tonna bilan yuqorida tenglashdi, Turkiya esa 180 eksport qildi. task2.title: Space tourism: positive or negative development?
task2.prompt: Space travel has been possible for some time, and some people believe that space tourism could be developed in the future. Do you think this is a positive or negative development?
task2.instruction: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
task2.sampleBand8:
Human beings have travelled into space for decades, and some now predict that ordinary tourists will soon be able to follow. In my view, the growth of space tourism would be, on balance, a positive development, although it brings drawbacks that must be managed carefully.

There are several reasons to welcome the idea. Most obviously, a commercial space-tourism industry would create a powerful new source of funding and competition, driving the technological breakthroughs that also benefit satellites, communications and scientific exploration. It would generate jobs and revenue and, over time, could make space access dramatically cheaper. There is a human dimension too: astronauts describe seeing the Earth from orbit as a life-changing experience that deepens their concern for the planet, and allowing more people to share this could strengthen global environmental awareness.

Nevertheless, the concerns are serious. In its early years, space tourism will be prohibitively expensive, an exclusive luxury for the super-rich at a time when many basic human needs remain unmet, which strikes many as unjust. The environmental cost is also significant: each rocket launch burns enormous amounts of fuel and releases pollutants high in the atmosphere, so a boom in joyrides could accelerate climate change. Finally, the risks to inexperienced passengers are far from negligible.

In conclusion, despite the genuine issues of cost, safety and pollution, I believe the innovation, investment and inspiration that space tourism would bring make it a broadly positive development — one that governments should nonetheless regulate to keep it safe and environmentally responsible.

Insonlar o'nlab yillar davomida kosmosga sayohat qilib kelmoqda va ba'zilar endi oddiy sayyohlar ham tez orada ularga ergasha olishini bashorat qilmoqda. Menimcha, kosmik turizmning o'sishi umumiy hisobda ijobiy hodisa bo'lardi, garchi u ehtiyotkorlik bilan boshqarilishi kerak bo'lgan kamchiliklar keltirsa-da.

Bu g'oyani olqishlash uchun bir qancha sabab bor. Eng yaqqoli, tijoriy kosmik turizm sanoati yangi kuchli moliyalashtirish va raqobat manbayini yaratib, sun'iy yo'ldoshlar, aloqa va ilmiy izlanishlarga ham foyda keltiradigan texnologik kashfiyotlarni ilgari suradi. U ish o'rinlari va daromad yaratadi, vaqt o'tishi bilan esa kosmosga kirishni keskin arzonlashtirishi mumkin. Insoniy jihat ham bor: kosmonavtlar Yerni orbitadan ko'rishni sayyoraga bo'lgan tashvishni chuqurlashtiradigan hayotni o'zgartiradigan tajriba deb ta'riflaydi, ko'proq odamga buni his qilishga ruxsat berish esa global ekologik ongni kuchaytirishi mumkin.

Shunga qaramay, tashvishlar jiddiy. Dastlabki yillarda kosmik turizm haddan tashqari qimmat bo'lib, ko'plab asosiy insoniy ehtiyojlar qondirilmagan bir paytda o'ta boy odamlar uchun mumtoz hashamat bo'ladi, bu esa ko'pchilikka adolatsizdek tuyuladi. Ekologik xarajat ham salmoqli: har bir raketa uchirilishi ulkan miqdorda yoqilg'i yoqadi va atmosferaning yuqori qismiga ifloslantiruvchi moddalar chiqaradi, shu bois zavq uchun sayohatlar gullab-yashnashi iqlim o'zgarishini tezlashtirishi mumkin. Nihoyat, tajribasiz yo'lovchilar uchun xavflar ham arzimas emas.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, narx, xavfsizlik va ifloslanishning haqiqiy muammolariga qaramay, men kosmik turizm keltiradigan innovatsiya, sarmoya va ilhom uni umuman ijobiy hodisaga aylantiradi deb hisoblayman — hukumatlar uni xavfsiz va ekologik mas'uliyatli saqlash uchun baribir tartibga solishi kerak bo'lsa-da.
